home.title: A museum that keeps the memory of the Rio 2016 Games alive
home.lead: 13 thematic cores, interactive experiences and the full collection of the Rio Olympic and Paralympic Games.
home.about_title: Where the story of the Games continues
home.about_text: An official member of the Olympic Museum Memory network, the Rio Olympic Museum is an educational, social and environmental platform that preserves and celebrates the legacy of the Rio 2016 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
home.mission_text: To be an educational, social and environmental platform that preserves and celebrates the legacy of the Rio 2016 Games.
home.vision_text: To become a cultural reference in South America, bridging sport, education and social transformation.
home.exp_lead: A complete journey through the history, behind-the-scenes and legacy of the Games.
home.acervo_lead: Torch, medals, uniforms, photos, videos and testimonials. All cataloged and accessible.

home.newsletter_text: News, exhibitions and educational activities, once a month.
